units.source_text: 折回方才的房间后，我一边揩试身体，一边板着面孔开始说道：

en.t: After returning to the room from before, I began speaking with a stern face while wiping my body.

units.source_text: 我出世时，佛祖托梦于我母亲，并告诉她这孩子成人后，

en.t: When I was born, the Buddha appeared to my mother in a dream and told her that when this child grew up,

units.source_text: 如果有女人衷心崇拜他的脚，她就定能极乐往生了。

en.t: if a woman worshiped his feet with all her heart, she would surely be reborn in paradise.

units.source_text: 虔诚的寡妇手捻念珠，定睛望着我眼睛在听我的讲述。

en.t: The devout widow fingered her prayer beads and listened to my story, staring fixedly into my eyes.

units.source_text: 我信口念经，然后将挂着念珠的手合在胸前，

en.t: I chanted sutras off the top of my head, then joined my hands, with the prayer beads hanging from them, before my chest,

units.source_text: 活像一具死尸似地赤裸着身体仰躺了下来。

en.t: and lay down naked on my back, looking exactly like a corpse.

units.source_text: 我会上双眼，嘴里依然念念有词。

en.t: I closed both eyes, while my mouth still kept muttering words.
